summary: Derby v4 final verdict: vcf wins head-to-head; control's anchored 2nd was inflation
repo accreted to 26 worktrees / 57 branches; 21 orphaned by 3 dead session PIDs
reclaimed 21 orphaned worktrees + 40 merged/empty branches -> 15/17 (reclaim_worktrees.py)
promoted worktree->merge->remove to canonical workflow + liveness-aware janitor
added worktree session recorder (worktree_session.py)
added lab event log + viewer (lab_log.py)
added 'fan out to preserve context' convention (conventions.md + CLAUDE.md + skill)
reconciled AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md to two standalone native twins (dropped @import, brought to parity, sync-guard notes)
encourage push of main once merged (both twins + canonical doc + conventions Class-B carve-out)
Phase 4 LIVE: first real 15x15 training run launched (wandb d6z4o5dw); single GPU tenant; v8 recipe minus vcf-teacher (cold start, no warm-start loader yet)

G15-seed cold-start fast-attack phase: plies 44->11, VL RISING 0.21->0.36 (not terminal collapse which needs low-VL); pl declining, epoch 63. CONTINUE per charter; warm-start is the remedy (champion defensive priors).

SWAP: G15-seed restarted WARM-STARTED (wandb qvr95npw) from 9x9 champion tower (94.6% transfer). plies_mean 79-89 from epoch 0 vs cold runs collapse to 11-13 — warm-start skips the 15x15 fast-attack collapse. Cold run d6z4o5dw retired.
Warm run climbing: epoch 93 anchored elo 1253 (heuristic 60/la2 75/la4 35%), plies stable ~30 (efficient not collapsing, VL declining). Improvement workflow wx2qh95qd in flight.

FIRST external strength datapoint: warm 15x15 net ~even with Rapfi (Gomocup 2625) at 200ms (2-2-0) and 25% at 1000ms (1-3-0), ~epoch 180. Small-n hint. Anchored ladder saturating (~1634-1699); Rapfi now primary signal.

Rapfi trend POSITIVE: epoch ~300 hits 67% vs Rapfi at BOTH 200ms (4-2-0) and 1000ms (4-2-0), up from 50%/25% at epoch ~180. Net is gaining on Gomocup-2625 over training (small-n, consistent across tiers).

FPU eval-lever does NOT transfer to 15x15: clean A/B on frozen e358 ckpt vs Rapfi — FPU-off 50/83%, FPU-on 33/83% (identical at 1000ms, within-noise at 200ms, n=6). Unlike the mature 9x9 champion. Deprioritized; not baked into eval default.

Rapfi trend e503: 67% @200ms (flat vs e300), 83% @1000ms (UP from 67%). Strength stable-to-rising THROUGH the pl loss-bounce (1.2-1.37, now back to 1.20, plies stable ~34) — bounce confirmed benign. Net solidly competitive with Gomocup-2625, esp. deeper TC.

Both levers merged (#25 bit-packed buffer, #26 WDL/G15-wdl contestant, byte-identical-OFF). Base plateauing ~67% vs Rapfi (e300-e600 flat-ish). Phase shift: contestants ready (G15-vcf, G15-wdl); next = plateau-break (3M packed buffer flood-smoke and/or net2net 96x8).

BREAKTHROUGH: e784 the 15x15 net BEATS Rapfi (Gomocup-2625) — 88% @200ms (7-1-0), 100% @1000ms (8-0-0), n=8. NOT plateaued — broke through from e600 67/50. Patience right: did NOT derby. Caveat: short TCs, not tournament-length. Recalibrating ladder harder (5000ms).

RECALIBRATION: harder eval shows ~67% vs Rapfi at BOTH 1000ms and 5000ms (holds vs deeper Rapfi = real edge). The e784 100% was small-n noise. Aggregate e300-e860 ~67% for ~500 epochs = PLATEAU CONFIRMED. vl still declining (0.18) = 64x4 refining but near ceiling vs Rapfi. Derby (capacity lever) now warranted.

DERBY started: grew champion (64x4, ~67% vs Rapfi) -> 96x8 via net2net (output-equiv 1.6e-4), swapped GPU to G15-96x8 (1.55M params, warm start plies~33 NO collapse). Bet: capacity breaks the ~67% plateau. Champion preserved g15_champion_e909.pt. Base stopped (GPU-serial).

DERBY e173 (first 96x8 eval, ~155 epochs into capacity): 62% @1000ms, 75% @5000ms ≈ 64x4 champion ~67% (aggregate 69%, within noise). No clear capacity gain YET (expected early). Plan: keep training, re-eval e350; give-up criterion if still flat. Slight 5000ms edge mildly encouraging.

DERBY VERDICT: capacity (64x4->96x8) PAYS at DEEP time control. 96x8 5000ms: 75%(e173)->88%(e343), both >64x4's ~67%. 1000ms flat ~62% (no gain at fast TC). Bigger net evaluates better -> edge compounds with more search. 96x8 is the stronger player for competitive (long-TC) play; keep training (edge growing). Preserved g15_champion_96x8_e343.pt.

CAPACITY WIN CONFIRMED + BROADENING: 96x8 vs Rapfi over 3 evals — 1000ms 62->62->75% (now >64x4 67%), 5000ms 75->88%. Capacity pays and widens with training. Preserved g15_champion_96x8_e499.pt. Grew 128x10 seed (3.3M params, net2net 1.8e-4 equiv) to ride the thesis. Next: launch G15-128x10.

GPU-SERIAL SWAP: stopped G15-96x8 (preserved e367/e499/e532), launched G15-128x10 (second capacity step, 3.3M params, net2net-grown from 96x8 e499, wandb b3g06cns). Warm start (workers generating ~3.5s/game). Re-eval ~150-300 epochs into capacity vs 96x8 baseline 75/88.

RUNAWAY caught on G15-128x10: per-epoch wall climbed 62→313s (new games/epoch 168→512, reuse 0.72→0.65) — the slow 3M-param trainer was FLOODED by 8 workers (gen outpaces trainer; ingest cost grows with inflow). FIX: killed workers 8→4 (halve inflow, no restart). LESSON: big nets (slow trainer) need FEWER workers to avoid the gen-flood runaway.

128x10 e195 verdict: 50% @1000ms / 88% @5000ms. The deep-TC 88% MATCHES the 96x8's MATURE peak but at only ~175-into-capacity (96x8 needed ~325-499). So 128x10 is TRACKING/on-track with room to exceed; low 1000ms mirrors the 96x8's own early-1000ms weakness (which later climbed to 75%). KEEP TRAINING, re-eval ~e400. The 1000ms-only read would've wrongly pivoted — waiting for both tiers (capacity-sensitive 5000ms) caught it.

CAPACITY LADDER VERDICT: 128x10 OVERSHOT. Aggregate 1000ms across e195+e556 = 37.5% (6-10/16), WORSE than 96x8's 75%; at-best-equal at 5000ms (e195 88%). The mature 3.3M net got WORSE at fast TC (e195 50% -> e556 25%). FINDING: capacity outran data — the 3.3M net overfit the 400k buffer. 96x8 (75/88) is the CHAMPION; capacity sweet-spot ~96x8 at this data scale. NEXT: test the data hypothesis — bigger bit-packed buffer (#25). Killed the slow 5000ms eval (decision settled, freeing CPU).

DATA EXPERIMENT launched: 96x8 champion resumed with a 1.5M BIT-PACKED buffer (#25 finally in use — 32x smaller, 479 vs 15300 B/pos). Tests whether more data pushes the sweet-spot net past 75/88 + avoids the 128x10 overfit. From g15_champion_96x8_e499.pt; 8 workers (96x8 fast enough, no flood).

DATA EXPERIMENT CRASHED — bit-packed buffer hits MPS INT_MAX: as the packed buffer grew past ~550k positions, the unpack materialized a tensor > INT_MAX (capacity x 3825 unpacked-plane elements > 2.1B) and MPSGraph crashed the trainer at e404. 400k unpacked never hit it; packed @1.5M does. FINDING: bit-packing (#25) has an MPS-scale bug — needs chunked unpack to stay under INT_MAX. The validate-at-flood-scale lesson AGAIN (unit tests + small smoke passed, real scale crashed).

MPS INT_MAX bug FIXED + merged (chunked unpack in replay_buffer.py; _planes_view materialized the whole buffer >INT_MAX at ~561k rows, hit every cycle via shape_stats). 32x packing intact, OFF byte-identical, >600k-row test green. Relaunched G15-96x8-bigbuf (1.5M packed) from the 96x8 champion — now must sail PAST ~550k positions. A real systems contribution to #25.

Data axis verdict: 96x8 + 1.5M bit-packed buffer did NOT beat the 400k champion. e597 vs Rapfi = 50% @1000ms (4-4-0) / 88% @5000ms (7-1-0) vs champion's 75/88 — deep-TC IDENTICAL. 96x8 is capacity-bound (88% deep-TC is its architectural ceiling), not data-bound. Loss plateaued before eval. Next: 128x10 + 1.5M buffer (capacity+data jointly). Negative result, clean single-axis A/B.

Capacity x data interim (e146): 128x10 + 1.5M buffer vs Rapfi = 75% @1000ms (6-2-0) / 50% @5000ms (4-4-0). BIG BUFFER CURED THE OVERFIT: same 128x10 net was 37.5% @1000ms on FROZEN 400k, now 75% on 1.5M (= 96x8 champion fast-tier). Deep-TC 50% still BELOW 96x8's 88% but e146 is EARLY for a 3.3M net (96x8 deep-TC itself climbed 75->88 over e173->e343). NOT a verdict: overfit cured (win), ceiling question OPEN. Re-eval ~e250/e350.

Capacity x data CONFIRM (e248): 128x10+1.5M vs Rapfi = 88% @1000ms (7-1-0) / 75% @5000ms (6-2-0). BOTH TIERS CLIMBED from e146 (75/50): fast 75->88 (now ABOVE 96x8 champ's 75%), deep 50->75 (climbing toward, not yet past, 96x8's 88%). Trains-into-capacity confirmed. ~Tied in aggregate at HALF the 96x8's training (e248 vs e499; 96x8 deep-TC hit 88 only ~e343). Capacity+data is WORKING; ceiling-break verdict deferred to ~e350. Lesson: capacity & data are COMPLEMENTS, and capacity costs training-time to convert into deep-TC strength.

Capacity x data REALITY CHECK (e348): 128x10+1.5M vs Rapfi = 88% @1000ms (7-1-0) / 62% @5000ms (5-3-0). Deep-TC trajectory 50->75->62 = NOISE not climb (n=8 ±18% band, true ~60-65%, BELOW 96x8's 88%). NO CEILING BREAK. The e248=75 'climb' over-read a single noisy point (the n=8 trap, caught by our own rule). Fast-tier ROBUST (88% twice > champ 75%); deep-tier LOWER than 96x8. So 128x10+bigbuf = better fast-TC, worse deep-TC — opposite of the 64x4->96x8 capacity-pays-at-depth story. Launched n=16 deep-TC re-eval to pin true value. Candidates: (a) still early need e500+, (b) deep-TC ~88 is recipe/search-capped not net-capped, (c) noise hiding ~75. 96x8 champ STANDS.

data.next: n16 deepTC re-eval + train to e500
